mesh.loftedReadOnly: A lofted mesh is read-only here: convert it to vertices + faces first
mesh.noneUnused: Every vertex is in a face
mesh.confirmReplace: Replace the whole mesh with the primitive?
mesh.view3dTip: 3D view, key 4. Orbit: middle button + Shift (or Alt + drag)
mesh.toolSelectTip: Select and move vertices (S). Click an edge to select its two vertices, inside a face to select the face; drag on empty space for a box.
mesh.toolAddTip: Add vertices (A): click on the view plane; new vertices join the selection in order, ready for Make face
mesh.displayTip: Wireframe shows every edge (smooth edges dashed); vpy3d shows only what vpy3d_draw_mesh draws from this angle (W)
mesh.snapTip: Snap moved and added vertices to the grid in the front/top/side views
mesh.notJson: This document is not a .vmesh JSON object. Add a primitive to start a new mesh (it replaces the text).
mesh.loftedBanner: Lofted from {{n}} sections: a read-only preview.
mesh.convertTip: Replace the sections with the vertices and faces they loft into, so they can be edited
mesh.name: Name
mesh.hardTip: Two faces meeting more sharply than this keep their shared edge as a line (vpy3d "hard"). 45 is the default; 0 = every edge is a line.
mesh.hardCosNote: "hard_cos" is set and overrides the angle.
mesh.openTip: A plate rather than a solid: its rim is drawn from either side
mesh.capsTip: Close the two ends of the loft
mesh.selectHint: Click a vertex, an edge or a face. Shift adds; drag a box on empty space.
mesh.makeFaceTip: Make a face from the selected vertices, in the order you selected them (F)
mesh.connectTip: Connect two corners of the same face: splits the face along a new edge (J)
mesh.disconnectTip: Remove the edge between two vertices by merging the two faces either side (K)
mesh.flipTip: Reverse the winding of the selected face (N)
mesh.deleteTip: Delete the selected vertices (and their faces) or the selected face (Del)
mesh.windTip: Re-wind every face anticlockwise seen from outside (normal away from the centre)
mesh.unusedTip: Delete vertices that no face uses
mesh.addPrimTip: Add the primitive at the origin, next to what is there
mesh.replacePrimTip: Replace the whole mesh with the primitive
mesh.flippedTip: Wound inward: vpy3d flips its normal at load, but it is better wound outward
mesh.valid: Compiles, and vpy3d can load it.
mesh.errorsNote: Errors: vpy_cli refuses the file (the build fails). Warnings: it builds, but vpy3d may refuse or misdraw it.
mesh.help: Middle drag: pan · Shift+middle or Alt+drag: orbit · wheel: zoom · 1-4: views · F face · J connect · K disconnect · N flip · Del delete · arrows nudge (Shift ×10) · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y
